other_conditions: Must be a member of a Multi-Purpose Agricultural Cooperative Society (MPACS).
Must not have any loan or borrowing from any bank or MPACS.
Must not be a defaulter of any government or private institution.
Must be eligible to take a loan under the Deendayal Upadhyaya Krishi Kalyan Yojana.
Must have own land or a registered lease/patta land.
Must be able to arrange for the remaining 250 chicks on their own.
benefits_summary: Provides 500 chicks free of cost and interest‑free loans for poultry shed construction and chick rearing, enabling farmers to rear 750 chicks annually.
